sample: One fresh full conversion of Downloads/10.png; existing models for 10.png, 11.png and 12.png reopened in Blender and visually inspected.
scope: Subjective static-display quality assessment; not a benchmark, rigging test or autonomous model evaluation.
findings: Front preserves recognizable outfit, pose and much of the face.
Tablet silhouette is warped; hands and props are not cleanly separated.
Face and hair detail are soft; face projection stretches at oblique views.
Side textures stretch and rear surfaces are lumpy with blurred color.
Packed 2048x2048 albedo, UVs and zero nonmanifold base-mesh edges passed technical checks.
No armatures; static display meshes only.
next_steps: Correct face, hands, feet and prop geometry on a versioned Blender mesh.
Create consistent side/back reference art before refining unseen surfaces.
Repaint/rebake side and rear textures after geometry correction.
Require visual acceptance of multiple views separately from technical validation.
